description: An abstract PHP class for setting up and managing test fixtures in the OrangeHRM project, including methods for obtaining services, dumping fixture data, and abstract methods for content and filename.

classes.name: AbstractFixture
classes.description: An abstract class providing common fixture functionalities such as retrieving services, dumping fixture data, and abstract methods for content and filename specification.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Returns an instance of TextHelperService, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: dumpFixture
methods.description: Serializes fixture content into a YAML file in the test fixtures directory, after verifying the database connection does not start with 'test_'.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide fixture content as an array.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Abstract static method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the filename for the fixture.
